you behold this eldritch altar. It has

feeling overcomes you.

spans.t: An altar dedicated to unholy abominations.
Just by staring at it, you feel your worst
self resurfacing, albeit with a new purpose.
You see a small bundle on its base, and as
you touch its stony facade you realize it
has been coated with a toxin.
3t
2t

spans.t: 2t
A stack of literary treasures in an unlikely
location. Filled with worry and some
selfish thoughts, you are relieved to find
a Trinket. You rise to your feet with your
confidence boosted and your morale lifted.

spans.t: A long-forgotten strongbox sits on the
cold stone floor. You praise your luck
and greedily open it, when a serrated
scalpel slashes your hand. From blood
at least comes bounty, as you discover
some coins and a valuable Trinket.

the backdrop of corruption. You open the

spans.t: A bookshelf full of old, leather-bound books.
As you reach out for a big tome, a sharp
ornament falls and slashes your hand. An
intense pain rushes through you, only to
be washed away by your renewed vigor.

spans.t: A big bookshelf looms in front of you. As
you reach out for a book, a spiky ornament
falls onto your head and your cheek gets
slashed from the impact. You look around
and find a Trinket on the bookshelf’s side.
Now you just need to stop the bleeding...

spans.t: A forsaken confession booth. It hasn’t been
used in years. As you step inside, you feel a
faint chill followed by a painful sting. As you
shake the poisonous spider off your garment,
you notice some coins on the booth’s floor.

the offering, a feeling of guilt washes over you.

pain, as you notice a tiny springblade slashing
at your hand when a hidden compartment
with some Provisions is revealed.

spans.t: A rusty iron maiden stands against the wall,
clasped shut. You feel tense as you try to
open the devilish contraption. Alas, you pin
yourself onto one of the spikes by accident.
You curse your luck as you break free,
feeling nauseous and sick.
Iron Maiden

spans.t: Excited by the prospect of abandoned
treasures, you yank the case open. A spring-
loaded blade sails towards your head but
well-honed reflex save you all but a shallow
cut on your cheek. Shaken, you collect some
dusty coins and carry on with the journey.
3t

spans.t: There could be valuables left inside. You
open it but you trigger a bladetrap. As it
swooshes by your shoulder, you duck but
manage to get slashed on the side of your
chin. Agitated and clearly shaken, you collect
the coins and the provisions found in the
cabinet and carry on with your journey.

amidst the ruins. As you examine
the helmet, it clams shut trapping

break free but your carelessness has
resulted in an oncoming fever.
